versos.texto_bv: E endurecerei o coração dos egípcios, para que entrem atrás deles; e serei glorificado em Faraó e em todo o seu exército, nos seus carros e nos seus cavaleiros.
versos.traducao_literal: E eu, eis-me endurecendo o coração do Egito, e virão atrás deles; e serei glorificado em Faraó e em todo o seu exército, no seu carro e nos seus cavaleiros.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A ênfase pronominal do hebraico foi omitida: וַאֲנִי הִנְנִי מְחַזֵּק (“e eu, eis que eu endureço”) marca contraste enfático com o “e você” do v. 16, mas a BV traz apenas “E endurecerei”. Restaurar a ênfase (“E eu, eis que endurecerei”) exigiria acrescentar conteúdo, o que ultrapassa a revisão de forma. — evidência: termos_originais: וַאֲנִי (HC/Pp1cs) + הִנְנִי (HTm/Sp1cs); traducao_literal: “E eu, eis-me endurecendo”; KJV: “And I, behold, I will harden”. O v. 4 traz “E eu endurecerei” justamente onde o hebraico NÃO tem o pronome — a ênfase ficou invertida entre os dois versos.

kjv.texto: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

vizinhos.16: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
vizinhos.18: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

web.texto: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall go in after them: and I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

vizinhos.16: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go into the midst of the sea on dry ground.
vizinhos.18: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh, when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”

versos.texto_bv: E os filhos de Israel entraram pelo meio do mar em seco; e as águas foram-lhes como muro à sua direita e à sua esquerda.
versos.traducao_literal: E vieram os filhos de Israel no meio do mar na terra seca, e as águas para eles muro, da sua direita e da sua esquerda.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): “Como muro” converte em símile a metáfora nominal do hebraico: וְהַמַּיִם לָהֶם חֹמָה diz que as águas ERAM para eles muro, sem partícula comparativa. Corrigir (“foram-lhes um muro”) alteraria o sentido figurado do texto aprovado, portanto o texto não muda. — evidência: termos_originais: חֹמָה (HNcfsa) sem כְּ comparativo; traducao_literal: “as águas para eles muro”; KJV: “the waters were a wall unto them”. O mesmo ocorre no v. 29.

kjv.texto: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

vizinhos.21: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
vizinhos.23: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

web.texto: The children of Israel went into the midst of the sea on the dry ground, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand, and on their left.

vizinhos.21: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all the night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
vizinhos.23: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the midst of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

versos.texto_bv: Mas os filhos de Israel caminharam em seco pelo meio do mar; e as águas foram-lhes como muro à sua direita e à sua esquerda.
versos.traducao_literal: E os filhos de Israel andaram na terra seca no meio do mar, e as águas para eles muro, da sua direita e da sua esquerda.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): “Como muro” converte em símile a metáfora nominal do hebraico (וְהַמַּיִם לָהֶם חֹמָה, “as águas eram para eles muro”), como no v. 22; a correção alteraria o sentido figurado, portanto o texto não muda. — evidência: termos_originais: חֹמָה sem כְּ comparativo; traducao_literal: “as águas para eles muro”; KJV: “the waters were a wall unto them”. A repetição integral da cláusula em relação ao v. 22 é refrão do próprio original e foi corretamente preservada.

kjv.texto: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

vizinhos.28: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
vizinhos.30: Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

vizinhos.28: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.
